moves.name: 5HP
moves.notes: 1f less recovery on block

moves.name: 5MK
moves.notes: 2f less recovery on block

moves.name: 5HK
moves.notes: ; extends a hurtbox 1f before active that is vulnerable to projectiles

moves.name: 2HK
moves.notes: Fully cancelable sweep with good range; cancel does not allow a combo follow-up on grounded hit or counter-hit (requires Punish Counter or airborne juggle); Punish Counter puts the opponent into a limited juggle OTG bounce state with extra hitstop for an easy hitconfirm; useful juggle tool that keeps the opponent airborne but only has slight juggle potential itself; forward movement leaves Arjun very close to the opponent on block if not canceled; cancel into 236LP creates a safe frame trap on block; Arjun lifts up his front leg hurtbox on frames 6-14, making it strong vs. low pokes; extends a hurtbox 1f before active that is vulnerable to projectiles; extends a projectile invincible head hurtbox upwards on frames 2-17 (but still in a crouching state)

moves.name: j.LP
moves.notes: Fast air-to-air with strong horizontal hitbox priority

moves.name: j.MP
moves.notes: Puts airborne opponents into a limited juggle state; lower body projectile invuln 8-22f (if used immediately on the way up, can avoid the 2nd hit of JP's OD Amnesia bombs)

moves.name: j.HP
moves.notes: Cross-up (can connect even from a point blank forward jump); spike knockdown vs. airborne opponents; 1st active frame can only hit forward while the final active frame can only hit cross-up (2 separate hitboxes overlap during the middle 4 active frames); extends a large downward hurtbox that makes it vulnerable to otherwise weak anti-airs (like many 5LP/2LP/2MP attacks); lower body projectile invuln 10-22f except around attack hitbox (cannot be used to avoid the 2nd hit of JP's OD Amnesia bombs)

moves.name: j.LK
moves.notes: Strong downward hitbox priority; can be used as a fuzzy instant overhead if the opponent is in Burnout

moves.name: j.MK
moves.notes: Greatest horizontal range of Arjun's air normals; lower body projectile invuln 9-26f (if used immediately on the way up, can avoid the 2nd hit of JP's OD Amnesia bombs)

moves.name: j.HK
moves.notes: Reaches farther downward than Arjun's other air normals (more likely to punish whiffed normals / projectiles / throw techs and harder to anti-air on reaction); knocks down the opponent on any hit (no follow-up combo is possible making it less rewarding than most air normals); lower body projectile invuln 10-21f except around attack hitbox (cannot be used to avoid the 2nd hit of JP's OD Amnesia bombs)

moves.name: 5MK~HK
moves.notes: 3f gap between hits on block; knocks down on counter-hit/Punish Counter (canceling into Super does not combo off the knockdown)

moves.name: 5HP~HP
moves.notes: Always a true blockstring; HP/HK follow-ups can only be input on hit

moves.name: 5HP~HP~HP
moves.notes: () refers to scaled damage from 5HP~HP combo starter; cannot be input on block; only combos in the corner (opponent is too far to connect midscreen)

moves.name: 5HP~HP~HK
moves.notes: Chases the opponent down for strong midscreen oki; cannot be input on block

moves.name: 5HK~
moves.notes: Allows the TC to combo after a 5HK Punish Counter launch (full charge) or a high anti-air connect (partial charge)

moves.name: LPLK
moves.notes: ; a successful Throw Escape builds 0.5 Drive bars for the defender; Throw Escape is awarded to a random player if input simultaneously

moves.name: 4LPLK
moves.notes: Side switch; a successful Throw Escape builds 0.5 Drive bars for the defender; Throw Escape is awarded to a random player if input simultaneously

moves.name: HPHK
moves.notes: See Drive Impact. Airborne connect gives spinning juggle state on Punish Counter or corner Wall Splat with variable height.

moves.name: 6HPHK
moves.notes: Performed by holding 6HPHK on wakeup; 5f extra recovery on hit; does not have any screen freeze except for a 12f freeze when interacting with the opponent's throw hitbox (this also refunds 1 Drive bar after punishing the throw); see Drive Reversal.

moves.name: MPMK
moves.notes: See Drive Parry. Perfect Parrying has only 1F of recovery and disables the opponent from canceling their attack. Perfect Parrying projectiles puts you into fixed 11 frames of recovery. After a Perfect Parry, all Super Gauge gain is reduced by 20% and Drive Gauge gain/damage is reduced by 50% for the entire punish combo.

moves.name: MPMK~66
moves.notes: See Drive Rush; 1-bar version performed out of a Parry; startup refers to minimum time before an attack can cancel the Drive Rush animation (if performed immediately after a successful Parry, only 1+8 startup); the first 15 recovery frames are cancelable into any attack; the final 22 recovery frames are cancelable into any attack or movement option or blocking (except Parry); only Normal and Command Normal attacks are enhanced with +4 frame advantage and improved juggle properties; Distance: ? (min/throw), ? (min/block), ? (max/final DR frame)

moves.name: MPMK or 66
moves.notes: See Drive Rush; 3-bar version performed on hit/block from a cancelable normal; can also be performed on whiff from cancelable light normals; startup refers to minimum time before an attack can cancel the Drive Rush animation; the first 15 recovery frames are cancelable into any attack; the final 22 recovery frames are cancelable into any attack or movement option or blocking (except Parry); only Normal and Command Normal attacks are enhanced with +4 frame advantage and improved juggle properties

moves.name: 236HP
moves.notes: 3f extra recovery on whiff

moves.name: 236PP
moves.notes: 3f extra recovery on whiff

moves.name: 623LP
moves.notes: Launches opponent slightly upward followed by a limited juggle OTG bounce state; transitions into Justice Beyond when colliding with an active Divine Pillar; deals 600 recoverable damage on block (stacks with chip damage if the opponent is in Burnout); the active frames end immediately on block/parry or when absorbed by armor followed by a fixed 23f recovery (cannot be made safer on block with meaty timing)

moves.name: 623MP
moves.notes: Launches opponent slightly upward followed by a limited juggle OTG bounce state; transitions into Justice Beyond when colliding with an active Divine Pillar; deals 700 recoverable damage on block (stacks with chip damage if the opponent is in Burnout); the active frames end immediately on block/parry or when absorbed by armor followed by a fixed 23f recovery (cannot be made safer on block with meaty timing)

moves.name: 623HP
moves.notes: Reaches fullscreen; launches opponent upward followed by a limited juggle OTG bounce state; transitions into Justice Beyond when colliding with an active Divine Pillar; deals 800 recoverable damage on block (stacks with chip damage if the opponent is in Burnout); the active frames end immediately on block/parry or when absorbed by armor followed by a fixed 23f recovery (cannot gain extra block advantage with meaty timing)

moves.name: 623PP
moves.notes: Reaches fullscreen; launches opponent upward followed by a limited juggle OTG bounce state; transitions into Justice Beyond when colliding with an active Divine Pillar; deals 800 recoverable damage on block (stacks with chip damage if the opponent is in Burnout); the active frames end immediately on block/parry or when absorbed by armor followed by a fixed 23f recovery (cannot gain extra block advantage with meaty timing)

moves.name: 214K~623P
moves.notes: Occurs automatically when Cruel Shoulder connects with a placed Divine Pillar (startup is counted from the frame Arjun reaches the pillar); will auto-correct if Arjun is behind the opponent when swinging the pillar; no difference between strengths of Cruel Shoulder or Divine Pillar (including OD versions)

moves.name: 236K
moves.notes: No difference between button strengths; projectile dissipates on contact with opponent

moves.name: 236KK
moves.notes: 2 hits; projectile moves forward slightly while active; can input follow-up even after projectile connects with opponent

moves.name: 236K~6P
moves.notes: Button strength determines the projectile angle (LP straight, MP 45 degree angle, HP nearly vertical); shockwave has an initial hitbox in front of Arjun for 10 frames followed by a launched projectile; if the initial Breathing Ring was dissipated on hit/block or by colliding with another projectile, only this short range shockwave will come out (less useful in ranged fireball wars)

moves.name: 236KK~6P
moves.notes: Button strength determines the projectile angle (LP straight, MP 45 degree angle, HP nearly vertical); shockwave has an initial hitbox in front of Arjun for 10 frames followed by a launched projectile; if the initial Breathing Ring was dissipated on hit/block or by colliding with another projectile, only this short range shockwave will come out (less useful in ranged fireball wars)

moves.name: 214K
moves.notes: Button strength determines pillar distance (LK close, MK middle, HK far); holding the button results in a delayed activation

moves.name: 214KK
moves.notes: Button combination determines pillar distance (LK+MK close, LK+HK middle, MK+HK far); holding the buttons results in a delayed activation

moves.name: 63214P
moves.notes: Deals recoverable damage to the opponent (cannot K.O. a low-health opponent); if the opponent already accumulated any recoverable damage, it instead deals actual damage and can K.O. the opponent; can be comboed into on grounded opponents but cannot be canceled into from normals

moves.name: 63214PP
moves.notes: Deals recoverable damage to the opponent (cannot K.O. a low-health opponent); if the opponent already accumulated any recoverable damage, it instead deals actual damage and can K.O. the opponent; takes a step forward on startup similar to 236PP; can be comboed into on grounded or airborne opponents but cannot be canceled into from normals

moves.name: 22HK
moves.notes: Absorbs any strike or projectile attack (including Super Arts) without incurring any recoverable damage; automatically performs a counter-attack when absorbing a strike (but not a projectile); can walk forward or backward while holding button (walk speed: 0.02 in either direction); counter-attack will autocorrect to face the opponent if they switch sides

moves.name: 22HK~P
moves.notes: 11-hit OD-priority projectile hitbox; can be used to safely pressure without the threat of Drive Impact or reversal SA1

moves.name: 236236K
moves.notes: 12-hit Super-priority projectile hitbox; aims near the ground before sweeping outward and upward (less range on early active frames but reaches fullscreen on the final 2 hits); can hit cross-up (even on grounded opponents if they extend a forward hurtbox while behind Arjun); useful juggle ender; can be used as an anti-fireball tool at mid range (less like to punish if clashing with multiple projectile hits)

moves.name: 236236P
moves.notes: Available at 25% HP or below; cinematic time regenerates ~2.3 Drive bars for Arjun
